name: Micro-textura de gradiente
description: Examina regiones suaves en busca de micro-textura natural de los sensores de camara.
mechanism: Analiza image gradiente fields para detectar unnaturally smooth regions lacking micro-texture. AI images produce suspiciously clean gradiente transitions especially in backgrounds.
parameters: Gradient operator: Scharr, Window: 16x16 sliding, Metrics: gradiente entropía, smoothness ratio
accuracy: Moderada - 70-80%, higher for diffusion model outputs
source: Nataraj et al. (2019) Detecting GAN generated Fake Images using Co-occurrence Matrices
useCase: Identifying generado por IA smooth gradientes lacking natural micro-texture

references.title: Fridrich, J. & Kodovsky, J. (2012). Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images. IEEE TIFS.
Tanaka, K. et al. (2019). Distinguishing Computer Graphics from Natural Images. Digital Investigation.

strengths:
• Detection vùng gradiente quá sạch đặc trưng AI
• Chi phí tính toán thấp
• Hoạt động tốt với ảnh có vùng mượt lớn
limitations:
• Las imágenes de estudio bien capturadas pueden causar falsos positivos
• Efectividad reducida después de agregar ruido
• Depende del contenido de la imagen
